categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in IC design, focusing on power management and analog ICs, smart application ICs, and electronic component distribution. It develops and sells integrated circuit products including USB Type-C PD fast charging chips, PWM power control chips, smart fan motor driver ICs, and customized ASICs. The company also engages in代理銷售 (agency sales) of internationally renowned electronic components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs fabless IC design, outsourcing wafer fabrication and packaging to leading foundries and packaging firms. Key technologies include USB Type-C Power Delivery, PWM and synchronous rectification power control, AI-enabled smart camera chips, motor control ICs for cooling solutions, and 8/32-bit microcontrollers. It integrates advanced semiconductor design with system-in-package (SiP) solutions and complies with international environmental standards like RoHS and Halogen Free.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Customers include global brands in personal computers, servers, gaming consoles, mobile devices, automotive electronics, and industrial control. The company serves end markets such as AI servers, 5G base stations, charging stations, solar inverters, mining machines, and payment terminals. Its products are widely used in PC, NB, smartphone, gaming, automotive, and industrial sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s sales are concentrated in Taiwan, China, South Korea, and Southeast Asia, with China accounting for approximately 74% of sales. It also serves global international brand customers across various regions. Manufacturing and supply chain partners are primarily located in Taiwan and China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as a fabless IC design house, positioned midstream in the semiconductor supply chain. It focuses on product planning, design, development, testing, and sales, while wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing are outsourced to foundries and packaging/test service providers. It also acts as a distributor for electronic components.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding power management ICs, smart application ICs, and motor control IC product lines, with emphasis on AI server cooling solutions. The company invests heavily in R&D (~NT$445 million annually) to develop energy-efficient, high-integration products compliant with evolving standards. It pursues acquisitions to enhance scale and market competitiveness, and focuses on sustainability and ESG initiatives including green supply chain management and climate risk mitigation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of self-developed ICs and agency sales of electronic components. The company also benefits from licensing/custom ASIC development for customers. Revenue streams include sales to OEMs and distributors across multiple end markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in power management and motor control ICs, holding global market leadership in secondary-side power management chips for PCs and gaming SPS. It competes with major IC design firms like MediaTek and TSMC in Taiwan’s semiconductor ecosystem. Its subsidiary has a significant share (>30%) in the server cooling fan motor IC market, positioning it as a key supplier in specialized IC segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$3.1 billion in 2024, a 7.25% increase from 2023, with net profit growth of 42.39%. It maintains a stable R&D investment and has a solid financial structure with total assets around NT$6 billion. The company has shown strong profitability improvement driven by product mix optimization and inventory management, with optimistic growth outlook supported by AI and high-performance computing demand.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes differentiated product functionality, superior quality, competitive pricing, and reliable delivery. It offers programmable digital power management ICs that reduce customer development risk and time, and leads in AI server cooling motor control ICs with advanced technology. Its commitment to environmental compliance, green products, and customer-specific ASIC solutions enhances its competitive edge and customer trust.
